title: Listening Drill — Street dance practice — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Street dance practice — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on street dance practice last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with sliding shoes. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: sticky patch.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of floor condition so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow clean shoes instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the dance tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Saturday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
